newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK- SHARES UP AGAIN, TRADE SLOWS.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK- SHARES UP AGAIN, TRADE SLOWS.

text.p: trading last week as clothing chain Pep put on 25 thebe
and two foreign counters, diamond giant De Beers and
financial services firm Forbes gained ground.
The domestic board added 7.61 points to finish at 542.71,
bringing value gains since January 1 to 54 percent in pula terms
and 56 percent in U.S. dollars. Pep ended at 335 thebe.
Turnover amongst local shares fell to 608,582 shares against
873,200 the week before and value was down at 2,643,216 pula
De Beers rose 72 thebe to 13,196 thebe and
Forbes put on 51 thebe to 747 thebe, but another
foreign share Avis shed 36 thebe to 656 thebe.
Turnover on the foreign board was down at 400 shares from
3,900 for value 15,304 pula. The index put on 0.84 points to
The all companies index added one point to close at 409.18.
